trajectory.thought: The leader is the seeded median baseline (a2) with an "indistinguishable" verdict over the runner-up, and the diagnosis explicitly favours a robust combination given the unstable ranking (Kendall tau 0.01) and correlated error groups. action_args.justification: The series is seasonally dominated with strong 52-week periodicity and moderate trend, but the model ranking is highly unstable (Kendall tau 0.01) and 11 of 19 models fall into correlated-error groups. Under these conditions a robust, unweighted median over the full pool avoids overfitting to any single window's ranking while retaining diversity. The dataset card independently ranks median among the top strategies. The leader is a seeded baseline and the runner-up margin is statistically indistinguishable, so further tuning is unlikely to yield a real gain.
